title: Israeli Strike Kills Hamas Finance Official and Bystander in Khan Younis; Woman Shot Dead in Bureij
detail: An Israeli airstrike hit a vehicle in the al-Mawasi area of western Khan Younis on Wednesday, September 23, 2026, killing two Palestinian men -- Mohammad Ibrahim Mohammad Abu Alwan, 33, of Rafah, and Osama Khaled Mohammad Abu Khater, of Bani Suheila -- and wounding two others. Prime Minister Netanyahu and Defense Minister Katz said in a joint statement that the strike, a joint IDF-Israel Security Agency operation, killed Abu Alwan, whom they described as a senior Hamas finance official, adding 'we will not allow Hamas to rebuild its strength, and we will not stop until Hamas no longer exists in Gaza.' No armed group claimed the two men as members. Separately in the Bureij refugee camp, central Gaza, Israeli quadcopter and helicopter fire hit residential areas; Noura Awni Diab, a Palestinian woman, was shot by Israeli forces and later died of her wounds. A fourth Palestinian, Yahia Sammour, was killed in the as-Sater al-Gharbi area. Gaza's Health Ministry and IMEMC logged the deaths on the 349th consecutive day of the nominal October 2025 ceasefire, alongside artillery shelling on Gaza City's Sikka Street, military vehicle fire in Beit Lahia, and helicopter attacks on western Rafah.

title: Son of Israeli Ambassador to US Critically Wounded in West Bank Car-Ramming Attack
detail: Neria Leiter, an IDF reservist and son of Israeli Ambassador to the United States Yechiel Leiter, was critically wounded around 5:00pm on Wednesday, September 23, 2026, when a vehicle rammed a checkpoint he was manning on Route 443 near the Beit Horon settlement in the West Bank. Magen David Adom medics found Leiter unconscious and evacuated him to Shaare Zedek Medical Center in Jerusalem, where he was listed in serious condition. The driver, identified by the Palestinian Ministry of Health as 29-year-old Mahmoud Muhammad Mahmoud Suleiman of the nearby village of Beit Ur al-Tahta, was shot dead at the scene. Ambassador Leiter said on social media he was 'grateful to the IDF, to the medical team at Shaare Zedek who are now fighting to save the life of Neria,' noting his son had served hundreds of reserve days since October 7, 2023 and continued serving after his older brother, Maj. Moshe Yedidya Leiter, was killed in Gaza in November 2023. Hamas praised the attack as a 'natural response' to Israeli actions in the West Bank and Jerusalem but did not claim responsibility.
